translationMode: browser on-device Translator API with local cache; source text is hidden until the selected-language rendering is ready
mixedLanguageFallback: prohibited; if a required translation cannot be created, the source body is not shown in the wrong locale and a localized unavailability notice is displayed instead
bylinePolicy: canonical author names remain proper names; هيئة تحرير الموقع is localized as Site Editorial Board / Rédaction du site; القرآن الكريم is localized as The Qur’an / Le Coran
